abstract: Public consultations are widely used in regulatory processes, allowing stake-holders to present their viewpoints despite their inherent biases. Some stake-holders, such as firms, are known to be pro-business, while others, such as environmental NGOs, are pro-environment. We develop a framework to analyze how a regulator should process information provided by biased stakeholders. We distinguish between stakeholders whose biases are high and known and those whose biases are small but unknown, such as national authorities. abstract_zh: 公众咨询在监管过程中被广泛采用，允许利益相关者表达其观点，尽管这些观点带有固有偏见。某些利益相关者，如企业，已知倾向于商业利益，而其他如环境非政府组织则倾向于环境保护。我们构建了一个框架，分析监管者应如何处理来自有偏见利益相关者的信息。我们区分了偏见程度高且已知的利益相关者与偏见程度小但未知的利益相关者，例如国家当局。研究表明，监管者应采纳与利益相关者通常偏见相悖的建议。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Environmental regulation informed by biased stakeholders
title_zh: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制

abstract: We propose a global games approach to the standard two-stage entry game. The entry decisions in the first stage are strategic substitutes. The second-stage game of product market competition reflects a fundamental common value “market attractiveness” parameter, about which firms get private noisy signals. The main result establishes the selection of a unique equilibrium in the entry game, as noise vanishes, in cut-off strategies implying efficient entry. This provides a theoretical foundation for the equilibrium selection commonly used in entry models in the empirical literature. In addition, using supermodularity techniques, we provide novel conditions of independent interest on the primitives (demand and cost functions) of market competition to justify our assumptions for Bertrand and Cournot competition. These include results on the effects of entry and demand shifts and highlight the critical relevance of the property of log-supermodularity of demand.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种全局博弈方法，用于分析标准的两阶段进入博弈。第一阶段中的进入决策表现为策略性替代关系。第二阶段的商品市场竞争博弈反映了一个基本的共同价值参数——“市场吸引力”，企业对此获得私人的噪声信号。主要结果确立了在噪声消失时，进入博弈中唯一均衡的选择，该均衡采用阈值策略，意味着有效率的进入。这为实证文献中常用的进入模型均衡选择提供了理论基础。此外，利用超模性技术，我们提供了关于市场竞争原始要素（需求与成本函数）的新颖条件，这些条件具有独立意义，用以证明伯特兰和古诺竞争假设的合理性。这些条件包括进入和需求变动效应的结果，并强调了需求对数超模性这一性质的关键重要性。
title: Efficient equilibrium in submodular global games of entry
title_zh: 次模全局进入博弈中的有效均衡

abstract: In this paper, we use high‐frequency transaction data to develop a weekly tracker for private consumption expenditures. Furthermore, we apply the transaction data in a nowcasting experiment and compare their performance with other, readily available indicators that are regularly linked to private consumption in Germany. The weekly tracker produces precise estimates and can thus be used in real time, especially in very turbulent times such as a pandemic or the high‐inflation‐phase in its aftermath. In terms of nowcast accuracy, the tracker outperforms all remaining indicators, making it a powerful tool for applied forecasting work. We intend to regularly publish the weekly consumption tracker in the future, thereby complementing the database for Germany.
abstract_zh: 本文利用高频交易数据构建了私人消费支出的周度跟踪器。此外，我们将交易数据应用于即时预测实验中，并将其表现与德国私人消费常规关联的其他 readily available 指标进行比较。该周度跟踪器能够产生精确估计，因此可实时使用，尤其在疫情或其后高通胀阶段等极为动荡的时期。在即时预测准确性方面，该跟踪器优于所有其余指标，使其成为应用预测工作的有力工具。我们计划在未来定期发布该周度消费跟踪器，从而补充德国的数据库。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: From Shopping to Statistics: Tracking and Nowcasting Private Consumption Expenditures in Real Time
title_zh: 从购物到统计：实时追踪与即时预测私人消费支出

abstract: ABSTRACT Despite being the smallest component of GDP, inventories represent the second largest source of GDP fluctuations. Over the past decades, research in inventory management has proposed competing theories about the primary drivers prompting firms to accumulate stocks, yet consensus remains elusive on the source of inventory cycles. This paper imposes structure on US macroeconomic data and disentangles four shocks related to current and expected demand and supply conditions within a unified framework. We find that at high frequencies sales forecast errors account for the largest share of inventory investment, giving support to the buffer‐stock motive for holding inventories. Shocks to expected demand and supply—which relate to stockout‐avoidance reasons for inventory investment—dominate inventory fluctuations at business‐cycle frequencies. We show that shocks to expected costs generate the missing positive correlation between cost‐driven inventory investment and sales that the literature has struggled to find, and that forward‐looking behaviours are those that lead production to be more variable than sales. Finally, our results offer a sensible narrative around the post‐pandemic period when inventories drove a very high share of GDP fluctuations.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管库存是GDP中占比最小的组成部分，却是GDP波动的第二大来源。过去数十年来，库存管理研究提出了关于促使企业积累库存的主要驱动因素的相互竞争的理论，但学界对库存周期的根源仍未达成共识。本文将结构施加于美国宏观经济数据，并在一个统一框架内分离出与当前及预期需求和供给状况相关的四种冲击。我们发现，在高频层面，销售预测误差占库存投资的最大份额，这支持了持有库存的缓冲库存动机。预期需求和供给冲击——与库存投资中避免缺货的动机相关——在商业周期频率上主导了库存波动。我们表明，预期成本冲击产生了文献一直难以发现的成本驱动型库存投资与销售之间缺失的正相关关系，并且前瞻性行为正是导致生产比销售更具波动性的原因。最后，我们的结果为疫情后时期提供了一种合理的叙事，当时库存推动了GDP波动中极高的份额。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Uncovering the Inventory‐Business Cycle Nexus
title_zh: 揭示库存与商业周期的关联

abstract: We set up a semi‐structural unobserved components multi‐country model of the eurozone. The common euro‐area natural rate of interest (NRI) is identified from the joint dynamics of the national data of its 20 member countries and estimated using Bayesian methods. Relative to a univariate approach, the model offers a substantial improvement in the precision of measuring the NRI and in the reliability of its real‐time performance. The results confirm previous findings of a secular decline in the NRI, with our model generating a smoother path. Estimation of different subgroups of eurozone countries indicates convergence of regional NRIs to the euro‐area NRI in the late 2010s and early 2020s.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个欧元区的半结构不可观测成分多国模型。欧元区共同自然利率（NRI）通过其20个成员国国家数据的联合动态加以识别，并采用贝叶斯方法进行估计。相对于单变量方法，该模型在自然利率测度的精确性及其实时表现的可靠性方面均有显著改进。结果证实了此前关于自然利率长期下降的发现，且我们的模型生成的路径更为平滑。对欧元区国家不同子组的估计表明，各区域自然利率在2010年代末和2020年代初向欧元区自然利率收敛。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: A Multi‐Country Approach to Estimate the Euro‐Area Natural Real Interest Rate
title_zh: 估算欧元区自然实际利率的多国方法

abstract: We propose a robust semi-parametric framework for persistent time-varying extreme tail behavior, including extreme Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES). The framework builds on Extreme Value Theory and uses a conditional version of the Generalized Pareto Distribution (GPD) for peaks-over-threshold (POT) dynamics. Unlike earlier approaches, our model (i) has unit root-like, that is, integrated autoregressive dynamics for the GPD tail shape, and (ii) re-scales POTs by their thresholds to obtain a more parsimonious model with only one time-varying parameter to describe the entire tail. We establish parameter regions for stationarity, ergodicity, and invertibility for the integrated time-varying parameter model and its filter, and formulate conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator. Using two cryptocurrency exchange rates, we illustrate how the simple single-parameter model is competitive in capturing the dynamics of VaR and ES, particularly in the extreme tail.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个稳健的半参数框架，用于刻画持续时变的极端尾部行为，包括极端风险价值（VaR）和预期损失（ES）。该框架建立在极值理论之上，并对超阈值（POT）动态采用条件版本的广义帕累托分布（GPD）。与早期方法不同，我们的模型（i）对GPD尾部形状具有类似单位根、即积分自回归动态，并且（ii）通过其阈值对POT进行重新缩放，从而得到一个更简约的模型，仅用一个时变参数来描述整个尾部。我们为积分时变参数模型及其滤波器建立了平稳性、遍历性和可逆性的参数区域，并给出了最大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性的条件。使用两种加密货币汇率，我们说明了这一简单的单参数模型在捕捉VaR和ES动态方面，尤其是在极端尾部方面，具有竞争力。
title: Joint Extreme Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall Dynamics with a Single Integrated Tail Shape Parameter
title_zh: 单一综合尾部形状参数下的联合极端风险价值与预期短缺动态

abstract: We evaluate alternative options for rebating revenues from a unilateral emissions price, focusing on emissions-intensive and trade-exposed industries. First, we develop a two-region and two-sector general equilibrium model and use it to demonstrate that rebating emission pricing revenues towards output increases and emission intensity reductions may be welfare-improving. These rebates are beneficial when emissions leakage and terms-of-trade changes are associated with the introduction of an emissions price, or when political constraints prevent the emissions price from fully reflecting the social cost of the emissions. We use a multi-region and multi-sector numerical simulation model to quantify the differences in welfare, leakage, terms of trade, output, and emissions across carbon prices with alternative rebating options for emissions-intensive and trade-exposed industries. The quantitative results indicate that from a domestic perspective, rebating emissions revenues proportionately to firm output is typically superior to other rebating options when the emissions price is set close to the social cost of emissions. Rebating emissions pricing revenues to reward reductions in emissions intensity is typically superior when emissions are significantly under-priced. A country that is more emissions-intensive and less exposed to leakage may prefer to rebate in proportion to total abatement when the emissions price is sufficiently low. The analysis highlights that incorrect choices of the rebating option can lead to substantial welfare losses.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了单边排放定价收入返还的替代方案，重点关注排放密集型且易受贸易影响的行业。首先，我们构建了一个两区域、两部门的一般均衡模型，并利用该模型证明，将排放定价收入返还用于促进产出增长和降低排放强度可能有助于提升福利。当排放定价导致排放泄漏和贸易条件变化，或当政治约束使排放价格无法完全反映排放的社会成本时，此类返还具有积极意义。我们采用多区域、多部门数值模拟模型，量化了不同碳价水平下，针对排放密集型且易受贸易影响行业的替代返还方案在福利、泄漏、贸易条件、产出和排放方面的差异。定量结果表明，从国内视角看，当排放价格设定接近社会成本时，按企业产出比例返还排放收入通常优于其他返还方案；而当排放价格显著偏低时，按排放强度降低幅度返还排放收入则更具优势。对于排放强度较高且泄漏风险较低的国家，若排放价格足够低，可能更倾向于按总减排量比例进行返还。分析强调，返还方案选择不当可能导致显著的福利损失。
title: Rebating Revenues from Unilateral Emissions Pricing
title_zh: 单边排放定价收入的返还

title: Piecewise linear feedback rules and weird quasiperiodic dynamics: Some general observations and two economic applications
title_zh: 分段线性反馈规则与奇异准周期动力学：若干一般性观察及两个经济学应用

abstract: Agricultural extension programs often train a subset of farmers and rely on social networks for knowledge dissemination. We evaluate this approach through a two-stage experiment of an agronomy training program among Rwandan coffee farmers. The first stage randomized trainee concentration at the village level; the second randomly selected participants within villages. The program increased knowledge and self-reported adoption of the taught practices. It also reshaped farmers’ social networks by creating new social ties primarily among co-trainees. At first glance, the intervention appeared modestly effective, with treated farmers exhibiting higher yields than control applicants within the same village, although this difference is not statistically significant. However, knowledge did not diffuse, and control farmers with more treatment friends at baseline reduced audited adoption and input use. Villages with high trainee concentrations showed suggestive evidence of negative spillovers, consistent with reallocation of labor and other shared inputs toward treated farmers, as formalized in a simple model in which social ties shape access to inputs. Relative declines in the yields of control farmers in these villages account for treatment-control differences, raising concerns both about this dissemination strategy and estimates that fail to consider potential negative spillovers.
abstract_zh: 农业推广项目通常培训一部分农民，并依赖社会网络进行知识传播。我们通过一项针对卢旺达咖啡农的农艺培训项目的两阶段实验来评估这一方法。第一阶段在村庄层面随机分配受训者集中度；第二阶段在村庄内随机选择参与者。该项目提高了知识水平及对所教授实践的自报采纳率。同时，它还通过主要在同批受训者之间建立新的社会联系，重塑了农民的社会网络。乍一看，该干预措施似乎效果适中，受训农民在同一村庄内的产量高于对照组申请者，尽管这一差异在统计上并不显著。然而，知识并未扩散，且基线时拥有更多受训朋友的对照组农民减少了经审计的采纳行为和投入品使用。受训者集中度高的村庄显示出负面溢出效应的初步证据，这与劳动力和其它共享投入品向受训农民重新分配的现象一致，正如一个简单模型所形式化的那样，该模型认为社会联系影响投入品的获取。在这些村庄中，对照组农民产量的相对下降解释了处理组与对照组之间的差异，这既对这种传播策略提出了质疑，也对那些未能考虑潜在负面溢出效应的估计提出了担忧。
title: Chat over coffee? Diffusion of agronomic practices and market spillovers in Rwanda
title_zh: 咖啡闲聊？卢旺达农业技术扩散与市场溢出效应

abstract: The ability to punish free-riders has been shown to sustain cooperation in social dilemma games. Those that engage in costly punishment are often those that are angry at observed contributions of their fellow group members. This paper abstracts from the effect of integral (i.e., related to the situation) emotions and explicitly studies the effect of incidental (i.e., unrelated to the situation) emotions. By inducing either positive or negative emotions we can causally investigate the effect of negative emotions on punishment or reward decisions in a one-shot public good game where personal and social interests are at odds. Our findings suggest that neither punishment nor reward per se are a function of induced (incidental) emotions. Induced emotions also do not have an effect on the probability to punish or reward. However, we find that conditionally on punishing, subjects that are induced to be in a negative mood punish group members significantly harsher than subjects who are induced to be in a positive mood. The handing out of rewards is not affected by induced moods.
abstract_zh: 惩罚搭便车者的能力已被证明能在社会困境博弈中维持合作。实施代价高昂的惩罚的人往往是那些对群体成员观察到的贡献感到愤怒的人。本文抽象出整体性（即与情境相关）情绪的影响，并明确研究附带性（即与情境无关）情绪的作用。通过诱导正面或负面情绪，我们可以在个人利益与社会利益相冲突的一次性公共品博弈中，因果性地考察负面情绪对惩罚或奖励决策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，惩罚或奖励本身并非诱导性（附带性）情绪的函数。诱导情绪对惩罚或奖励的概率也没有影响。然而，我们发现，在条件于惩罚的情况下，被诱导处于负面情绪的受试者对其群体成员的惩罚显著严厉于被诱导处于正面情绪的受试者。奖励的发放不受诱导情绪的影响。
title: The effects of induced emotions on punishment and reward
title_zh: 诱导情绪对惩罚与奖励的影响

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic led to unprecedented disruptions in global supply chains (GSC), coupled with large fiscal stimulus. This paper employs a proxy structural VAR model to examine GSC shocks, the Federal Reserve’s response, and their propagation under two counterfactual policy rules. Large fiscal stimulus amplifies inflation while cushioning the downturn from GSC shocks. Historically, the Fed has looked through price surges and adopted a loose stance. The first counterfactual, which stabilises inflation, entails less accommodation and yields a more favourable inflation-output trade-off, reflecting greater price flexibility and limited output losses. The second, which minimises a dual-mandate loss function under inflation targeting (IT) or average inflation targeting (AIT), calls for greater initial easing. Relative to IT, AIT implies a looser policy that generates more persistent inflation and ultimately requires a contractionary response, worsening the trade-off.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情导致了全球供应链（GSC）前所未有的中断，同时伴随着大规模的财政刺激。本文采用代理结构向量自回归模型，考察了全球供应链冲击、美联储的应对措施，以及在两种反事实政策规则下的传导效应。大规模的财政刺激在缓解全球供应链冲击引发的经济衰退的同时，加剧了通货膨胀。从历史角度看，美联储一直忽视价格飙升并采取宽松的政策立场。第一种反事实情景旨在稳定通胀，其政策宽松程度较低，却带来了更优的通胀-产出权衡，反映出更高的价格灵活性和有限的产出损失。第二种反事实情景在通胀目标制（IT）或平均通胀目标制（AIT）下最小化双重使命损失函数，则要求更大幅度的初始宽松。与IT相比，AIT意味着更宽松的政策，导致通胀更具持续性，并最终需要紧缩性应对，从而恶化了权衡关系。
title: Monetary policy trade-offs amid global supply chain disruptions
title_zh: 全球供应链中断中的货币政策权衡

abstract: This paper studies how rising returns to scale contributed to declining business dynamism and increasing markups and expenditures devoted to customer acquisition in the U.S. economy. It introduces a firm dynamics model with heterogeneous markups and customer accumulation based on directed search, in which larger firms gain a competitive edge from higher returns to scale. This makes markets less contestable for new firms and leads to the rise of superstar firms. The model quantitatively accounts for a substantial share of these trends, and the underlying micro-level mechanisms align with empirical evidence. • Superstar firms contribute to secular trends: declining business dynamism, increasing markups, and higher spending on customer acquisition. • Rising returns to scale amplify differences among firms, driving the growth of superstar firms. • Novel directed-search model quantitatively explains a substantial fraction of these secular changes via rising returns to scale. • The model also aligns with several micro-level phenomena associated with these secular trends.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了规模报酬递增如何促进美国经济中商业活力下降、加成率上升以及客户获取支出增加的现象。文章引入了一个包含异质性加成率和基于定向搜索的客户积累的企业动态模型，在该模型中，规模较大的企业因更高的规模报酬而获得竞争优势。这使得新企业面临的市场可竞争性降低，从而催生了超级明星企业的崛起。该模型在数量上解释了这些趋势的相当大一部分，其微观层面的机制与实证证据相符。• 超级明星企业推动了长期趋势：商业活力下降、加成率上升以及客户获取支出增加。• 规模报酬递增加剧了企业间的差异，推动了超级明星企业的成长。• 新颖的定向搜索模型通过规模报酬递增在数量上解释了这些长期变化的相当大一部分。• 该模型还与这些长期趋势相关的若干微观层面现象相吻合。
title: Customer accumulation, returns to scale, and secular trends
title_zh: 客户积累、规模报酬与长期趋势
